description: Do research with stopping criteria instead of vibes — five machine-checkable criteria (S1–S5) for when to stop, six breadth axes, nine associative-expansion directions (D1–D9), a journal template, and two CLI checkers that machine-verify a research journal and flag false confidence. Use when you are about to write a spec, design doc, or prompt that depends on facts you have not verified; when asked to research/investigate/look something up before starting; when reviewing whether an existing conclusion has traceable sources; or when you catch yourself citing a single secondary summary as if it were first-hand.
